message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes:

| Category | Typical Ingredients |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Fresh or dried pasta sheets (or no-boil sheets) |
| **Meat sauce** | 1–2 lbs ground beef or a mix of beef & pork, onions, garlic, crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt, pepper, oregano, basil, red pepper flakes (optional), a splash of red wine or beef broth |
| **Bechamel (white sauce)** | 4 tbsp butter, 4 tbsp all‑purpose flour, 4 cups milk (whole or 2% for richer flavor), pinch of nutmeg, salt, pepper |
| **Ricotta mixture** | 1–1½ cups ricotta cheese, 1 egg, ¼ cup grated Parmesan, chopped fresh parsley or basil, salt, pepper |
| **Mozzarella** | 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (part-skim or whole milk) |
| **Parmesan** | ½–¾ cup grated Parmesan (for topping) |
| **Optional extras** | Sautéed spinach, sliced mushrooms, zucchini, or bell peppers; a dash of red wine or balsamic glaze; fresh herbs (basil, oregano, thyme) |

**Assembly steps (brief):**

1. Cook lasagna sheets (or use no‑boil sheets).  
2. Prepare meat sauce: sauté onions & garlic, add ground meat, cook until browned, stir in tomatoes, season, simmer.  
3. Make bechamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk, cook until thickened, season.  
4. Mix ricotta with egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, pepper.  
5. Layer: start with sauce, then sheets, ricotta, mozzarella, sauce, repeat. Finish with mozzarella + Parmesan on top.  
6. Bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 35–45 min, until bubbly and golden. Let rest 10–15 min before serving.  

Feel free to adjust quantities based on the number of servings or personal taste!
